text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, tramadol hydrochloride 50 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 303 tablets with 18.1 tablets used per day, providing 16.7 days on hand. Corvale General holds 532 tablets with 18.4 tablets used per day, providing 29 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows tramadol hydrochloride is not listed as of 2026-10-21. The current product label names A-S Medication Solutions as the registered plant, which received a VAI inspection on 2026-08-12. A-S Medication Solutions has received multiple VAI inspections and a Warning Letter on 2017-06-05. Advagen Pharma Limited is not on FDA's shortage list and is manufactured at Rubicon Research Limited, last inspected NAI on 2024-03-08.

Our position: Corvale East's 16.7 days on hand is low relative to the current plant's inspection history, which includes a recent VAI and a prior Warning Letter. The top-ranked alternative, Advagen Pharma Limited, is not on FDA's shortage list and its manufacturing plant Rubicon Research Limited received an NAI inspection on 2024-03-08.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase orders for tramadol hydrochloride 50 mg tablets from Advagen Pharma Limited; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Advagen Pharma Limited as an approved vendor; requires pharmacy director approval.
3. Buyer to monitor inventory levels at both sites weekly; requires pharmacy manager approval.

Not recommended: Switching to Aurobindo Pharma Limited (plant last inspected VAI 2022-05-10) or Amneal entities (labels name no identifiable plant) while Advagen Pharma Limited offers a plant with a recent NAI inspection and is not on FDA's shortage list.
